title: TestReport
description: The artifact produced by the verify stage: the result of running the project's declared test command against a ChangeSet. See ADR-0004.

changeset_artifact_ref.description: Reference to the ChangeSet that was verified.

command.description: The exact command executed (from the theme's declared test command).

stdout_ref.description: Artifact reference to full stdout. Large; never inlined.

stderr_ref.description: Artifact reference to full stderr. Large; never inlined.
